leadText: Volume 2 is the second volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version.
plainText:
Volume 2 is the second volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version.

==Blurb==
 Scarlet and Violet are contacted by Cassiopeia, who recruits them to join Operation Starfall. Their mission is to bring down and disband Team Star, a group of troublemakers considered to be the delinquents of the academy!

Is Cassiopeia on the correct side?! 

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Adventure 4: Raid! The Dark Crew Base!!
Adventure 5: Challenge! DJ Giacomo!!
Adventure 6: Skillful! The Mysterious Treasure Hunter!!
